scripts.build: bun run --filter './system/*' build && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-elements build && bun run gen && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-react build && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-vue build && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-astro build && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-mcp build
scripts.gen: bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-elements gen && bun run tools/cem/src/registry.ts && bunx oxfmt tools/cem/registry.json && bun run tools/cem/src/wrappers/index.ts && bun run gen:argtypes
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:css && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:tokens && bunx sherif
scripts.render: bun run storybook:build && bun run --filter @rimltempest/riml-ds-storybook render
scripts.vrt: bash scripts/vrt.sh --project vrt-light-360 --project vrt-light-1024 --project vrt-dark-360 --project vrt-dark-1024 --project forced-colors --project reduced-motion
scripts.vrt:update: bash scripts/vrt.sh --update-snapshots --project vrt-light-360 --project vrt-light-1024 --project vrt-dark-360 --project vrt-dark-1024 --project forced-colors --project reduced-motion
scripts.release:check: bun run build && bun run gen && bun run design-md && git diff --exit-code -- library/elements/custom-elements.json tools/cem/registry.json DESIGN.md && bash scripts/release-check.sh && bunx size-limit && bunx knip && bunx sherif
scripts.postinstall: bun install --cwd tools/markuplint --frozen-lockfile || bun install --cwd tools/markuplint; bun run gen:argtypes
scripts.clean: find . -maxdepth 3 -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun install
